value.description: Current bounded value. Required for a bar; omit it when `points` is given.

max.description: Upper bound for the range. Defaults to `1` for fractional values.

label.description: Visible label for a bar. For a line (when `points` is given) it is the accessible name and is not drawn.

trailing.description: Optional trailing value such as a cost, token count, or percentage.

size.description: Track thickness and text scale. Default `md`. For a line, the height of the plot: 3rem, 6rem or 8rem.

points.description: Draws a trend line instead of a bar: the series, oldest first, on a scale from its lowest to its highest value. Values that are not finite are skipped.

startLabel.description: Line only: text under the left end of the baseline, such as "1.4 GB · 24 hours ago".

endLabel.description: Line only: text under the right end of the baseline, such as "Now".

theme.description: Partial visual theme override. Omitted fields inherit the surrounding application.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name override. Defaults to `${label}, ${percentage}%` for a bar, and to `label` for a line.

ariaValueText.description: Accessible value text override. Defaults to the trimmed trailing value when provided.
